question:
고위험 임신성 융모성 종양(high-risk GTN)의 1차 병합 화학요법으로 가장 적절한 치료법은 무엇인가?  
1) MAC (methotrexate, actinomycin D, chlorambucil) 
2) CHAMOCA (cyclophosphamide, hydroxyurea, actinomycin D, methotrexate, doxorubicin, melphalan, vincristine) 
3) EMA/CO (etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, vincristine) 
4) FAV (fluorouracil, adriamycin, vincristine) 
5) BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin)
answer: 3) EMA/CO (etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, vincristine)
